parameters.subject: [Action Required] Daily Newsletter Status Check

parameters.content:
### How it works

This workflow gives daycare staff an AI-powered dashboard to write, approve, and send daily parent newsletters without manual typing.

Staff open the web dashboard, upload photos from the day, and click Generate - GPT-4o-mini reads the photos and staff memo and writes a newsletter under 100 characters. Staff can edit the draft, then click Approve & Send. At 14:00 on weekdays, approved newsletters are emailed to each parent individually via Gmail. At 13:30, if any newsletters are still unapproved, a reminder email lists the children still waiting. Every night at 02:00, newsletters older than 30 days are deleted automatically. Holidays and weekends are skipped using a free public Japanese holidays API.

### Setup steps

1. Add your **OpenRouter API** credential to the Call OpenAI and Call OpenAI Regen nodes (get key at openrouter.ai)
2. Add your **Gmail OAuth2** credential to the Send Reminder Email and Send Email nodes
3. Create two n8n Data Tables: **children** (child_id, child_name, nickname, parent_name, parent_email, is_active) and **newsletters** (newsletter_id, child_id, date, status, ai_text, final_text, staff_memo, photo_1_binary, photo_2_binary, photo_3_binary, photo_count, created_at, approved_at, sent_at)
4. Enter your **staff email address** in the workflow setup card (Staff Config node) - reminder notifications will be sent there
5. Pre-load child records into the children table, publish the workflow, then open the dashboard URL printed in the Webhook node

Warning: The dashboard and API endpoints have no login. Share the URL only with trusted staff, or add authentication later.

## Dashboard - GET /newsletter-app

Loads child list and today's newsletter statuses from Data Tables and returns a fully interactive HTML page with Generate, Approve & Send, and Regenerate buttons per child.

## AI Generate - POST /generate

Accepts photos (base64) and a staff memo, calls GPT-4o-mini, and saves the generated text (≤100 chars) to the newsletters table with status Draft.

## Approve & Regenerate - POST /approve | /regenerate

Approve locks in the final text and marks the newsletter Approved. Regenerate re-runs the AI using the saved photos and memo and resets status to Draft.

## Reminder Check - Schedule 13:30 JST

On weekdays (holidays excluded), checks for unapproved newsletters and emails staff a list of children still waiting.

## Send to Parents - Schedule 14:00 JST

On weekdays (holidays excluded), emails each approved newsletter to the matching parent's Gmail address and updates status to Sent or Send Failed.

## Auto Delete - Schedule 02:00 JST

Deletes newsletters with status Sent that are older than 30 days. Runs every day including weekends.

nodeGroups.name: AI Generation

nodeGroups.description: Loops through and deletes Sent newsletters older than 30 days (runs nightly at 02:00 JST)
